question: Please calculate the monthly average levels of PM10, PM2.5 FRM, PM2.5 non-FRM, volatile organic emissions, SO2 (scaled by a factor of 10), and Lead (scaled by a factor of 100) air pollutants in California for the year 2020.
sql:
WITH pm10 AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm10_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_code = '06' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
pm25_frm AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm25_frm_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_code = '06' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
pm25_nonfrm AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm25_nonfrm_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_code = '06' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
voc AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.voc_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_code = '06' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
so2 AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 10 AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.so2_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_code = '06' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
lead AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 100 AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.lead_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_code = '06' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', p.month) AS month,
  ROUND(p.avg_value, 2) AS pm10,
  ROUND(f.avg_value, 2) AS pm25_frm,
  ROUND(n.avg_value, 2) AS pm25_nonfrm,
  ROUND(v.avg_value, 2) AS volatile_organic_emissions,
  ROUND(s.avg_value, 2) AS so2_scaled,
  ROUND(l.avg_value, 2) AS lead_scaled
FROM pm10 p
JOIN pm25_frm f ON p.month = f.month
JOIN pm25_nonfrm n ON p.month = n.month
JOIN voc v ON p.month = v.month
JOIN so2 s ON p.month = s.month
JOIN lead l ON p.month = l.month
ORDER BY p.month
